title: IPA Hématologie
text:
GénéralitésEntretiens


On ne travaille que sur les mots (ou pour être exact les racines des mots) en analysant uniquement leur fréquence dans le texte.

library("tidyverse")
library("dplyr")
library("readODS")
library("gtsummary")
library("kableExtra")

library("ggsci")

mesmots <- c("cest", "ça", "donc", "fait", "parce", "peut","quand",
             "être", "puis", "aussi", "plus", "fois", "là", "sous", "après",
             "peux", "alors", "beaucoup", "comme", "quil", "faut", "voilà",
             "vont","oui", "peutêtr", "ben", "peu", "tout", "car", "quelqu",
             "puisqu","ell","vraiment", "évidem", "non","jai", "sai", "déjà",
             "tous", "avoir","estc", "autr", "...", "quon", "ouai", "entr")


prof <- c("IDE en consultation", "Assistante sociale", 
          "Cadre supérieure de santé", "Pharmacien",
          "Pharmacien", "Cadre faisant fonction",
          "Hématologue", "Secrétaire médicale")




Code
importtxt <- function(ntxt){
add <- paste0("datas/entretien",ntxt,".txt")
tt <- readLines(add)
docs <- Corpus(VectorSource(tt))
toSpace <- content_transformer(function (x , pattern ) gsub(pattern, " ", x))
docs <- tm_map(docs, removePunctuation)
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, ",")
docs <- tm_map(docs, toSpace, "’")
docs <- tm_map(docs, content_transformer(tolower))
docs <- tm_map(docs, stripWhitespace)
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeWords, stopwords("fr"))
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeWords, mesmots)
docs <- tm_map(docs, stemDocument)
 #
dtm <- TermDocumentMatrix(docs)
m <- as.matrix(dtm)
v <- sort(rowSums(m),decreasing=TRUE)
docs <- data.frame(freq=v) |> 
  rownames_to_column(var="mot")
#
return(docs)
 }




Code
tabfq <- function(docs = docs){
kbl(head(docs, 10)) |> 
  kable_material(c("striped", "hover"))
}




Code
nuage <- function(d = docs){
  set.seed(1834)
gg <- wordcloud(words = d$mot, freq = d$freq, min.freq = 1,
          max.mots=300, random.order=FALSE, rot.per=0.35, 
          colors=brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
ggplotly(gg)
}




Code
figfq <- function(d = docs,nmax = 6){
  gg <- d |> 
  dplyr::filter(freq > nmax) |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = fct_reorder(mot,freq, .desc = FALSE), y = freq) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Mots les plus fréquents - IDE en consultation",
    y = "Fréquence",
    caption = "Nombre d'occurence des mots significatifs (réduits à leur racine)  les plus fréquents.",
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_fill_jama() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y.right = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none") +
coord_flip()
  
ggplotly(gg)
}
